philippines.title: 1,300 families flee homes due to skirmishes in BARMM town
philippines.description:
​TUGUNAN, BARMM-SGA — At least 1,346 families have been forced to flee their homes following a dawn clash between military forces and an armed group in Tugunan town, located in the Special Geographic Area (SGA) of the Bangsamoro region. ​According to Situation Report No. 01 released at 5:00 p.m. Saturday by the Bangsamoro Rapid Emergency Action on Disaster Incidence (READi), the displaced residents are spread across three barangays: Manaulanan (789 families), Balong (334 families), and Macabual (223 families). ​The evacuation followed a tactical operation launched around 6:30 a.m. in Sitio Gawang, along the boundary of Barangay Manaulanan and Barangay Balong.
